features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — No migrations. composer.lock changes: the Flysystem S3 driver comes in, with the Amazon SDK pruned to S3 only (6 MB instead of 68). Nothing changes for self-hosters and zip installs: documents stay in storage/app/private/documenti with the same names; the 172 document tests passed without touching one.

DOCUMENTS HAVE A DISK, AND THE DISK IS CONFIGURABLE — Fifty spots across nineteen files wrote `local` and `public` by hand; now one service, ArchivioDocumenti, knows where uploaded files live (archive, units, suppliers, contacts, invoices, transfer deeds) and the print signature. DOCUMENTI_DISK=local (default) is the disk as always; DOCUMENTI_DISK=s3 puts them on an S3-compatible bucket (Cloudflare R2, Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, MinIO) with the standard AWS_* variables and a prefix (DOCUMENTI_PREFIX). On S3 downloads stream, the print signature is copied to a temp folder for mPDF, the preview is a signed expiring URL, the bucket stays private. Changing the value does not move files already uploaded. With documents on S3 the built-in backup does not include them, and the backups page says so.

IF S3 DOES NOT ANSWER YOU KNOW AT ONCE, AND NOTHING IS LOST — A write to a wrong bucket used to be silent: six screens would have said «created» while writing a row without a file. Now a failed upload is an error with its message and no row; an unreachable signature does not stop a print; and `kondomanager:verifica-persistenza`, run by the Docker image at every start, writes, reads back and deletes a probe object: a wrong bucket stops the container with the right message.

IN THE CONTAINER, EPHEMERAL DOCUMENTS = UNAVAILABLE — /up reports where documents live (esterni, su_volume, effimeri) and, only inside the Docker image (KM_CONTAINER=1), documents on the local disk without a volume make the installation unavailable (503). Outside the container nothing changes. verifica-persistenza knows the disk and warns when, with S3, backup archives stay in a container without a volume.
A STORAGE CAP, SHOWN AND NOT ENFORCED — LIMITE_SPAZIO_MB (absent, empty or 0 = no limit). Usage is the sum of the documents' file_size column plus the signature. Shown, not enforced.

«THIS INSTALLATION» — A new settings page: buildings against the cap (demo ones count, and it says so), storage against the cap only when there is a cap, enabled functions (in-app updates, external scheduler, built-in backups, external storage), where documents live, the version, and «Manage your plan» only if the host provided an address (GESTIONE_PIANO_URL). The functions map is shared with every page as `funzioni`. Four languages. `kondomanager:stats --json` gives the host the same numbers.

BOTH UPDATE PATHS WALK THE SAME LIST — `kondomanager:aggiorna` re-listed by hand five of the seven steps of SystemFinalizer::finalize(): a new seeder hooked to one path only would have silently missed the other. Now there is one list, passiDatabase(), with a test that pins it and loads municipalities and ATECO from empty tables through the command.

THE BETA.32 IMAGE WAS WITHDRAWN — .dockerignore excluded storage/app/private and public but not storage/app/backups: the 1.11.0-beta.32 image on ghcr.io contained four backups of the development database (only download: the staging server). Package deleted; .dockerignore now excludes all of storage/app and every hidden file at the root, a test guards the file, the build context was measured.

THE WORKFLOW THAT PUBLISHES THE IMAGE — On every v* tag it builds the amd64 image, really starts it with a service MySQL and a volume (install from variables, /up 200 within three minutes, no .env or dev packages inside) and only then pushes to ghcr.io/vince844/kondomanager-core; `latest` only on stable tags. The real test is the first tag.
